hypothesis: A public quantitative postcondition can supply a partial oracle for an API with no original call donor. Source types bind the transform, input bound, measure, and options; source test literals supply a restricted input domain.

domain.strings: First eight distinct printable ASCII string literals from original tests, including empty if present. No ANSI control sequences or Unicode-width claims.
domain.options: Zero options, then one public string or bool field. String option length is not restricted to the bound.
domain.candidate_order: source pair, host test, options configuration
domain.host: Preserve the complete first supported original same-package test; append the partial-property loop.

native_policy: Uniform generator for all 17 source trials. Source controls, exact edit transport, first controlled assertion failure and one repeat. No replacement based on independent semantic audit.
authority: Provider sees public issue and declarations/documentation only. It must justify the entire input domain and units. Type compatibility, exact quotation, passing original tests, and native failure do not prove the law.
novelty: The contribution hypothesis is construction of contract-linked partial test obligations when the original suite has no target-API call donor. The scalar upper-bound relation itself is not claimed as new.
limitations: Both transform and measure can share a defect; this is not an independent reference implementation.
An upper bound cannot detect empty output, content loss, or style corruption.
Printable ASCII input does not guarantee printable ASCII output. The source-bound public measure remains part of the obligation.
The prototype still needs a supported original test host and source string literals.
All 17 trials have already influenced method development.
Selected relations remain hypotheses. Every emitted alert requires independent complete-test review.
Both selected relations belong to one API family. Only the root wrapper has a supported original test host; all 11 native candidates use that wrapper.
The original repository tests contain no direct calls to either selected target API. The source constructor still reuses an original host test and literal pool.

validation.scope: quantity constructor, discovery selection and driver, exact candidate edit transport

semantic_audit_timing: The file named pre_execution_audit was sealed after all three native executions. Its author had not read native results or provider completion reasoning. This is outcome-blind review, not pre-execution preregistration.
root_cause: Source inspection shows that truncation clamps the prefix width budget to zero when the tail is longer than the width, then appends the entire tail without bounding it. Native runs record measured width 7 for a width budget of 1; they do not record returned output bytes.
decision: Retain for a uniform whole-component combination. The 1 newly verified trial is not added to the best score until the combination is frozen and checked.
